name: Model runtime
description: Your local model-runtime as an assistant provider: its installed models join the model list in Settings → Assistant and the chat's model selector, with load and unload there. Requests go only to the runtime's socket on this computer.

baseUrl.title: Address
baseUrl.description: Runtime address: unix:/path.sock or an http(s) URL. Empty uses $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/model-runtime.sock.

typos.title: Typo fixes
typos.description: Offer typo fixes for prompts you compose for an agent

promptReview.title: Prompt review
promptReview.description: Review the quality of prompts you compose for an agent

commandSuggest.title: Command suggestions
commandSuggest.description: Suggest a shell command from a plain-language request at the prompt

terminalCompletions.title: Terminal completions
terminalCompletions.description: Ghost-text completion of the command you are typing at a shell prompt (sends the line, the folder, recent commands with exit codes and pane chips such as the git branch; never output)

editorCompletions.title: Editor completions
editorCompletions.description: Inline completions in the editor (sends the code around the cursor)

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: The assistant chat pane and Ask in the command palette

explainError.title: Explain error
explainError.description: Explain error on a failed command block (sends that command and its output when you click it)

requestsPerMinute.title: Request limit
requestsPerMinute.description: Most requests per minute for each feature
